This is a bail application U/S.483 of the BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Spl. GR Case No.44 of 2021 arising out of Bonai PS Case No. 41 of 2021 pending in the Court of learned Addl. District Judge-cum-PO, Special Court (POCSO), Sundargarh for commission of offences punishable U/Ss. 451/376(1)/307 of IPC and Sec. 4 of POCSO Act, on the main allegation of committing rape and penetrative sexual assault upon the victim by trespassing into her house and administering phenyl liquid to kill her.

entities.text: Addl. District Judge-cum-PO, Special Court (POCSO), Sundargarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Heard, Ms. Anita Dash, learned counsel for the Petitioner appearing virtually; Mr. Susil Kumar Pattnaik, learned counsel for the Informant and Mr. P. Satpathy, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.
4.

After having considered the rival submissions upon perusal of record, there appears serious allegation against the petitioner for attempting to the life of the victim, so also for committing rape and penetrative sexual assault upon her, but it is admitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the case is right now posted for defence evidence which suggests that the case would likely to be disposed of in near future.

In such situation and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis--vis the allegation sought to be brought against him and keeping in view the evidence of witnesses so far examined and taking into account the other circumstances on record in entirety including the statement of the victim, this Court is not inclined Satya Swain vs State Of Odisha ...
